title: Delhi-NCR rain chaos: Capital under orange alert; WFH advisory issued for Gurgaon
content: Heavy rains lashed Delhi-NCR on Monday, causing significant waterlogging and traffic congestion. Authorities in Gurgaon issued a work-from-home advisory for August 25 due to the downpour. Several key roads and underpasses in Delhi also experienced severe water accumulation. Flight operations were disrupted, with fifteen Delhi-bound flights being diverted. Civic teams were deployed to manage the situation and clear waterlogged areas.

title: Dhruv shines like a jewel in Colombo; makes the opportunity(ies) count
content: With his place under pressure and Sarfaraz Khan breathing down his neck, Dhruv Jurel delivered when India needed him most. His hard-earned hundred in Colombo could be the knock that turns a make-or-break series into a career-defining one. India declared their first innings at 503 for 9 as only 53 overs were possible on Day 2.

title: What Flock Safety CEO said on people vandalising Flock cameras across America
content: Flock Safety's CEO advocates for a compromise between privacy and public safety concerns.  The company faces criticism and vandalism over its surveillance technology deployment.  Reports detail police misuse of Flock cameras, prompting an apology from the CEO.  Flock has reduced data retention and requires case codes for access.  The CEO also calls for stronger regulations on surveillance data misuse.

title: ‘You don't know what happened’: After Maha cliff tragedy, aunt rejects iPhone claim
content: The aunt of a deceased teenager has released an emotional video pleading for an end to unverified claims. She stated that false narratives about the family's tragedy are circulating widely on social media. The family is already struggling with immense grief and distress from the recent deaths. She appealed to social media users to consider the family left behind before posting.

title: Mumbai Marathi rule protest: Auto driver beaten, passengers dragged out amid outcry
content: An autorickshaw driver faced assault from protesters opposing the Marathi language proficiency drive. Demonstrations occurred in several Mumbai locations, including Kandivali and Malad West. Some protesters disrupted services and forced passengers to deboard their vehicles. Misinformation about fines fueled panic among drivers unable to speak Marathi. The situation normalized later in the day after police intervention.

title: Stamping of boarding passes for immigration clearance to be discontinued from Sept 1
content: From September 1, international travelers departing from India are set to benefit from a new policy that eliminates the necessity for boarding pass stamping at immigration counters. This initiative aims to enhance the efficiency of the travel process. Passengers have the option to present their boarding passes, either in electronic format or as a printed copy.

title: US is building a fortress around China. Its shrinking missile stocks could be the weak link
content: The United States faces a critical precision weapon shortage.  This deficit impacts its ability to deter Chinese aggression in the Pacific.  Current global conflicts have depleted American military stockpiles significantly.  The US is now accelerating production and adopting new strategies.  This aims to counter China's growing military capabilities effectively.

title: Uttarakhand temple where Shiva-Parvati wedding fire still burns draws couples
content: Triyuginarayan Temple in Uttarakhand is becoming a popular choice for couples seeking a traditional Hindu wedding. Steeped in history, this revered site is thought to be the location of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati's union. Couples can light the sacred Akhand Dhuni and must register by paying a small fee while choosing an auspicious date, ensuring they receive a handwritten marriage certificate for legal documentation.

title: Should married women avoid keeping Ekadashi fast? What Hindu scriptures and traditional beliefs note
content: Married women often face scrutiny when observing the Ekadashi fast, but spiritual leaders emphasize there is no scriptural justification for this notion. The tales of King Ambarisha and Rukmanga illustrate that true devotion knows no marital boundaries. Over time, societal customs can sometimes be misinterpreted as religious commandments. Ultimately, Ekadashi is about deep spiritual devotion and personal growth.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years
content: The Primary School, founded by Priscilla Chan, has closed after a decade of operation.  Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, leading to the board's decision.  Academic results fell short of state benchmarks and leadership expectations.  Around 540 students will now join the Ravenswood City Elementary School District.  The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative provided financial support for the transition and student savings.

title: Ukraine marks 4th I-Day amid war: How drones & defiance stopped Russia’s war machine
content: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine has entered its fifth year.  The conflict has devolved into trench warfare, resembling the First World War.  Both sides face immense human and financial costs in this attritional struggle.  Ukraine's adaptability and Western support sustain its defenses against Russian advances.  This prolonged war tests endurance and reshapes Europe's security order.

title: Randi Mahomes reveals sacrifices as a single mother behind Patrick’s NFL rise
content: Randi Mahomes has opened up about the sacrifices she made while raising Patrick Mahomes and his siblings as a single mother. She recalled working long hours, missing school events, holidays and social moments, while carrying the responsibilities of both parent and provider. Despite the difficult trade-offs, Randi says she would make the same choices again. Her emotional reflections reveal the often unseen foundation behind Patrick’s NFL success.

title: Scottie Scheffler reveals painful battle with viral illness: What happened?
content: Scottie Scheffler revealed he battled hand, foot and mouth disease during the BMW Championship, where blisters on his hands made it painful to grip a golf club. Despite admitting he probably should have withdrawn, Scheffler pushed through to finish tied for 12th, citing his reluctance to quit mid-tournament. He now turns his attention to the season-ending Tour Championship at East Lake, hoping his health clears up in time to chase a second FedExCup title after a dominant win the week before he fell ill.

title: Why Leon Draisaitl backs Mike Babcock as Oilers coach for 2026-27 NHL season
content: Leon Draisaitl has publicly advocated for Mike Babcock to be the coach of the Edmonton Oilers in the 2026-27 NHL season, citing the coach’s accountability, clear plan and high standards. Following a rollercoaster 2025-26 campaign that ended with a first-round playoff exit, Draisaitl said Edmonton needs a new way of thinking. His comments add to a growing chorus of support for Babcock from Edmonton’s leadership group.

title: Putin credits PM Modi for growing Russia-India trade in talks with EAM Jaishankar
content: Russian President Vladimir Putin acknowledged Prime Minister Narendra Modi's role in strengthening bilateral ties.  He noted that trade turnover between Russia and India has significantly increased this year.  External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar conveyed good wishes and discussed economic cooperation details.  Both leaders anticipate future meetings at upcoming international summits.  The India-Russia partnership demonstrates resilience and adaptability amidst global complexities.

title: UP man marries 2nd time for son, kills wife after child’s birth
content: Police arrested a man for allegedly murdering his second wife eighteen months after their son's birth. He had married her hoping for a male child after having five daughters. The victim had left her first husband and married the accused, facing family opposition initially. Tensions escalated after the accused refused to accept her daughter from her first marriage.

title: ‘We'd be in office if educated’: Mumbai auto drivers block road over Marathi rule
content: Autorickshaw drivers in Mumbai began a three-day strike on Monday.  They are protesting the Marathi language requirement for their licenses.  Many older drivers lack formal education and struggle with the new rule.  Protesters face significant fines and demand reconsideration of the directive.  They seek justice and time to comply with the language mandate.

title: Cops used electrocution gloves to subdue high school students in Omaha, now the school district and parents are pleading with police to stop
content: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement plans to acquire electric-shock gloves for $20 million.  These devices were recently used on two Omaha high school students by officers.  Omaha's superintendent requested the police stop using the gloves in schools.  Bellevue police will continue carrying the controversial devices for student safety.  Experts and parents criticize the gloves as abusive and inappropriate for schools.

title: 'Have right to know': CJP demands clarity on funding, facilities in govt schools
content: Abhijeet Dipke is on a mission to uncover the state of government school infrastructure and staffing. He is probing ministers about the conditions of renovations and the number of teacher vacancies across various states. Additionally, he seeks insights on school funding and emphasizes the pressing need for more institutions. With an urge for immediate enhancements in public education, he raises flags about basic facilities and the workloads faced by educators.

title: Scientists overturned hundreds of rocks in Barbados and found the world's smallest snake
content: After a long absence of 20 years, scientists in Barbados have triumphantly rediscovered the world's tiniest snake, the Barbados threadsnake. This remarkable find, located under a rock during an ecological survey, measures just 3 to 4 inches long. The rediscovery is crucial for understanding the species' diminishing forest habitat, and conservationists are optimistic that this will bolster efforts to protect the remaining forests on the island.

title: ‘Free water parks for kids’: AAP takes dig at Rekha Gupta govt over Delhi waterlogging
content: Heavy rainfall lashed Delhi on Monday afternoon, causing widespread waterlogging and traffic disruption.  Several key areas experienced significant water accumulation, impacting daily commutes and businesses.  An Aam Aadmi Party leader criticized the Delhi government's handling of the waterlogging situation.  The India Meteorological Department predicted continued light rain across various parts of the city.  Similar rainfall was reported across several other Indian states on Sunday.

title: 'We can ask Pakistan and request them': Kapil asks 'better treatment' for Imran
content: Former India captain Kapil Dev has joined 21 former international captains in urging Pakistan to provide jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan with proper medical care and humane conditions. The group has asked Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to follow court orders allowing medical treatment and weekly family visits. Kapil stressed that the appeal is about Khan’s health, not his legal cases.

title: What is the scholarship that awards students for playing games? Roehampton’s esports scheme puts gaming on the university balance sheet
content: Roehampton University’s esports scholarship is challenging traditional ideas about student funding by offering financial support to students who excel in competitive gaming while maintaining academic progress. The initiative comes as concerns over university costs intensify, highlighting a wider issue: many students remain unaware of scholarships and bursaries that could ease financial pressure and reduce reliance on additional work.

title: ‘Fix schools, not lavish homes’: CJP targets Rs 92cr bill for ministers’ bungalows
content: The Cockroach Janta Party criticized the Centre's spending on ministers' residences.  They stated this money could build new world-class government schools.  The party noted a significant increase in renovation and repair expenditures.  They are reviewing the Centre's commitments after withdrawing their nationwide agitation.  Any failure to honor assurances will be considered a betrayal of the youth.

title: 'One tip one hand': English batter out in bizarre fashion in County match - Watch
content: Northamptonshire pacer Luke Procter bowled a short delivery that angled into left-handed Moores. The batter went back and defended the ball, which bounced close to the crease and appeared to be heading towards the stumps.

title: Delhi-NCR rain: 10 videos capture waterlogging, traffic chaos across region
content: Heavy rain lashed Delhi-NCR on Monday, causing significant waterlogging across the region. Commuters faced severe traffic disruptions and slow movement on key roads and highways. Several areas reported knee-deep and waist-deep water, impacting daily commutes and vehicle movement. Flight operations were also disrupted, with fifteen Delhi-bound flights being diverted to other airports. The India Meteorological Department had issued red and orange alerts for the severe weather conditions.

title: UPI instant payments network grows from 1.78 cr annual transactions to 24,162 crore
content: India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is currently facilitating an impressive 66 crore transactions each day. Since 2016, the growth in its transaction volume has skyrocketed by an astounding 13,000 times. UPI has established itself as a foundational component of India's digital public infrastructure and has been recognized by the International Monetary Fund as the leading real-time payment system globally.

title: At 13, UAE student builds AI education platform: How did he do it?
content: At 13, UAE student Adam Ahmed developed ScoolBot, an AI-powered, gamified education platform aligned with UAE Ministry of Education standards. After his first project reached the Top 20 in a DDS AI challenge, ScoolBot placed fourth and later earned Gold at the International AI Awards 2026 and TeenTech Awards 2026. While developing the platform, Adam also created Bothread, a free, open-source tool that helps AI coding agents coordinate tasks and avoid conflicts.

title: Red, orange alerts in Delhi: 15 flights diverted amidst heavy rain, thunderstorms
content: On Monday, Delhi-NCR experienced torrential rainfall, leading to severe waterlogging and significant traffic disruptions. A total of fifteen flights had to be redirected from Delhi airport as severe weather conditions unfolded. Commuters took to social media, sharing snapshots of inundated streets and halted transportation. Many areas reported water buildup, hindering daily travel and services. Passengers were advised by airlines to verify flight statuses before heading to the airport.

title: Bopanna blasts sports ministry rule as five tennis players miss Asian Games squad
content: The sports ministry's guidelines limited the Asian Games tennis squad to players ranked among the top eight in Asia. As a result, Manas Dhamne, Vaishnavi Adkar, Sahaja Yamalapalli, Vaidehee Chaudhari and Prarthana Thombare missed out on selection.

title: 'No sugar shortage': ISMA says India has enough stocks, prices to cool down soon
content: Industry representatives from India's sugar sector have assured that there is no shortage of sugar in the domestic market. The surge in retail prices is attributed to stockpiling speculation and adverse weather impacting production. To mitigate this, the government is facilitating duty-free sugar imports, particularly from Brazil, with some raw sugar expected to arrive before mid-October. Current domestic supplies are predicted to meet future demands adequately.

title: No relief for Rial: Iranian currency sinks to record low as US works on new sanctions
content: Iran's rial reached a record low as the United States prepared new economic sanctions.  Existing restrictions and a naval blockade have already severely impacted Iran's economy.  The currency's decline has not yielded concessions from the US President.  Iran and Oman are reportedly nearing an agreement on managing the Strait of Hormuz.  The United Arab Emirates suspended all trade with Iran following discussions with the US.

title: IUML in Keralam throws its weight behind Malappuram bifurcation demand
content: With a population of 41.3 lakh according to the 2011 Census, Malappuram is Kerala’s most populous district. Its population is estimated to be close to 48 lakh now

content: Lack of awareness, stigma and misconceptions continue to be the key reasons for the low turnout of lactating mothers donating milk at the Comprehensive Lactation Management Centre (CLMC) and Human Milk Banks

content: Three teams of forest officials constituted, and three veterinarians equipped with tranquillisers, he says

title: Mullappally flays Centre’s decision to shift Mangaluru from Palakkad railway division
content: Former KPCC president Mullappally Ramachandran terms the move “unilateral” and urges Keralam to stand united against it. He says the shift could cost the Palakkad division at least ₹600 crore in freight revenue.

content: Job openings range from relationship managers and business development executives to machine operators, production staff, pharmacists and trainees; candidates with qualifications from Class X and ITI to diploma, degree, B. Tech, MBA and B. Pharm can attend

content: The plant has been set up at a cost of ₹10,000 crore for an output of 1,325 Megawatts, according to an official release

content: Opened in 1968, Pilot Theatre was a landmark of Madras’s modern cinema culture, drawing audiences from across the city for decades

title: Mysuru voters drop by 5.57 lakh after SIR draft roll

content: In a letter to the Prime Minister, he says the decision was taken without consulting the Keralam government despite its implications for railway infrastructure and development in northern Keralam

title: CRPF jawan injured in gunfight, houses torched in Manipur's Senapati district
content: The incidents of arson in Senapati triggered protests as locals gathered at Senapati gate and burnt logs and tyres on National Highway 2, affecting movement of vehicles, the officer said.

title: ‘Political parties suppressing Kakinada ‘Love Jihad’ incident,’ laments former MP Vijaysai Reddy
content: Mr. Reddy posted the complete text of a five-page suicide note on X on Monday, revealing the modus operandi of the alleged Kakinada Love Jihad case

title: National resolve needed to preserve tribal languages, culture: Union Minister
content: Collective efforts were needed to safeguard tribal languages, traditions and cultural heritage, says Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Durga Das Uikey

title: Bengaluru: Man books 108 ambulance with fake murder call
content: During the conversation, the man allegedly abused the staff nurse and ambulance driver, accusing them of not reaching the location he had provided and not performing their duties.

title: ‘Where Is Rahul Gandhi?’: Telangana BJP over students’ fee reimbursement dues
content: Telangana BJP chief launches 48-hour hunger strike in support of students demanding the immediate release of around ₹15,000 crore fee reimbursement dues

title: Chittoor Sugar Factory marriage hall reopens after renovation
content: The facility has adequate parking, a dining hall, rooms, and a spacious function hall, making it suitable for various events, says MLA

title: BJP member Somu Veerraju demands probe by central agencies into alleged Kakinada ‘love jihad‘ case
content: The irony is that neither Home Minister V. Anitha nor DGP Harish Kumar Gupta responded to Love Jihad case till August 24, alleged Mr. Veerraju

title: First Vande Bharat Sleeper maintenance depot comes up in Jodhpur
content: DRM says ₹167-crore first phase nearing completion; facility to maintain three 24-coach sleeper rakes simultaneously within six hours

content: Committed to protecting interests of genuine owners and not allowing regularisation of Govt lands, he said

content: Value of recovered devices since January crosses ₹1 crore; SP urges public to immediately report missing phones through the Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) portal

content: The skills are effective communication, financial management, strategic leadership, critical problem-solving and adaptability, says Ashok Naik

content: The U.S. Embassy said Ambassador Gor in Srinagar met Chief Minister Omar Abdullah “to discuss strengthening bilateral ties and later visited Leh to experience Ladakh’s culture and traditions”

content: Welcome to the Karnataka Today newsletter, your guide from The Hindu on the major news stories to follow today. Curated and written by Nalme Nachiyar.

content: Whenever heavy rainfall hits, stormwater rushes rapidly down from the surrounding Aravalli hills and converges on the urban plains in Gurugram.

content: The warning came as British Prime Minister Andy Burnham pledged to keep backing Ukraine militarily during a visit to Kyiv.

title: "Against Federal Cooperatism": Revanth Reddy After Centre's No To US Visit
content: Revanth Reddy was denied political clearance for his trip to the US because the proposed programme for the visit was not "appropriate", the Ministry had said earlier.

title: From Haryana To Punjab: Why The BJP Is Betting On Satish Poonia
content: Satish Poonia is back to his signature style of election management. He is building grassroots poll blueprints, replicating his structured Haryana campaign approach.

content: The official said that bird strikes are not unusual, particularly during the rainy season when avian activity tends to increase.

content: Speaking to reporters, the parents said they were unable to come to terms with losing their son but wanted his death to give others a chance at life.

title: Explained: Why Tamil Nadu Dropped Second Airport Near Chennai
content: While the government stands firm with the protesting residents, Chief Minister Vijay assured that Chennai's aviation needs will not be ignored. The state will soon announce a detailed plan for a new airport at an alternative site, he said.

title: Opinion: Opinion | The Gulf's New Defence Agreement Has A 'Credibility' Problem
content: There is much talk of this pact bringing peace and stability to the region. For this, the three countries involved must be stable and peaceful themselves.

title: Railway Division Row Opens A New Front Between Kerala And Karnataka
content: The Railway Board order moves the Mangaluru area up to and including Ullal from the Palakkad division of Southern Railway to the Mysuru division of South Western Railway with effect from October 1

content: Residents of Gurugram - the 'Millenium City' - have complained that the collapse of civic infrastructure keeps repeating every time there is rain of a slightly longer duration

title: Heat, Humidity And Heavy Rains: What's Driving Delhi's Erratic Weather?
content: Normal life across the Delhi-NCR region was disrupted due to the heavy rainfall on Monday morning. Waterlogging on roads in several areas led to slow-moving traffic.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay announces 3 LPG cylinders, free bus travel for women, transgenders
content: TN CM Vijay announces 3 free LPG cylinders, expands free bus travel scheme for women . the amount for the cylinder will be credited directly to the bank accounts of eligible beneficiaries . under the cooking gas scheme, women will be allowed to travel free of charge on government buses operating in metropolitan and urban areas .

title: Ajit Doval in Beijing as India-China border tensions rise; what's on agenda?
content: NSA Ajit Doval arrives in Beijing for a two-day visit . he is set to hold the 25th round of special representatives' talks on the India-China boundary question . the talks come amid efforts by the two sides to gradually normalise relations .

title: Kashmiri Pandits under PM Package flag fresh threats; seek security
content: one employee said they would not be intimidated by the threats . the threat poster is allegedly circulated on social media targeting employees in the Kashmir Valley . a new threat letter was allegedly issued by an outfit called itself the United Liberation Council .

title: Why Vijay scrapped Chennai’s second airport plan at Parandur
content: the greenfield airport project at Parandur will affect agricultural land and disrupt livelihoods of farmers and residents . the government is considering alternative locations and plans to conduct technical feasibility studies before finalising a new site . he said he visited Eganapuram and other villages on January 20, 2025 .

title: Wash rice twice, not 7 times: Drought-hit England targets faith, cultural habits
content: a £270,000 campaign has urged people to wash rice fewer times . use a one-litre jug, not a running tap for wudu . three-quarters of England is in drought after five heatwaves this summer .

title: 'Monstrous, mindless': Chidambaram criticises 'One Nation, One Election' plan
content: former union minister opposes proposed framework before joint parliamentary committee . argued that synchronising elections could violate constitution governing elected legislatures . sources said curtailing their tenure would amount to a violation of basic structure of the Constitution .

title: ‘Taking part in Ukraine war’: Russia warns UK after Burnham hands Kyiv ‘secret tech’
content: the move has drawn a sharp warning from Moscow . it said British military support was adding fuel to the fire . the warning came as prime minister Andy Burnham arrived in Kyiv . he was expected to announce that Britain had authorised defence company MBDA to share previously classified information .

title: 'Govt has played delay games': CJP announces march from India Gate on Sept 5
content: the youth march will begin at India Gate and proceed towards the new Delhi police headquarters . the protest will be led by families of deceased NEET victims and victims of alleged police brutality . students and youth organisations expected to join the protest .

title: H-1B visa shock: Trump admin proposes hiking fee to over $100,000
content: proposed rule will now enter a 30-day public comment period . it would turn the controversial $100,000 H-1B payment into a formal regulatory requirement . move comes amid growing uncertainty around the H-1b programme . from $100,000 fee to permanent rule The proposed $103,265 charge follows Trump's 2025 proclamation .

title: 'Insult to 4cr people of Telangana': CM Reddy flays Centre over US visit block
content: revanth Reddy accuses the centre of "insulting" 4 crore people of the state . he says the move showed the "Centre's discrimination" against Telangana . the chief minister also questioned why he was allowed to visit the u.s. and canada .

title: Harvard urges int'l students to return to US before Sept 15; here's why
content: the recommendation applies to international students enrolled in on-campus programmes this autumn . the existing "duration of status" system would be replaced by a fixed period of authorised stay for many international students and scholars . those already in the US on September 15 and maintaining valid status would generally be allowed to remain until the later of their programme end date or the expiry of eligible post-completion work authorisation .
